Download prototype 0021.nds

Open the downloaded NDS in your Android DS emulator. Start a new game to test the opening, or import a backed-up prototype 004, 005, 006 or 007 normal save through your emulator. Emulator save states should not be transferred between builds.

This is an opening prototype, not a complete Yellow remake. Route 1 now opens after Mom gives you Running Shoes. The cashier greets you outside Viridian and escorts you into the Mart. Deliver Oak’s Parcel to receive the National Pokédex. Cerulean’s initial Yellow visit is converted. Route 24, Route 25, Bill and the returning robbed-house event follow in the next area checkpoints. Imported saves keep their caught records, but Pokédex access waits for parcel delivery. Challenge Misty’s Yellow team, meet Blue with his persisted starter, visit Melanie for Bulbasaur and exchange a Bike Voucher at the restored Bike Shop. The voucher comes from the Vermilion fan club in a later checkpoint. Pewter’s guide now automatically stops all exit lanes before Brock and walks around scenery to the gym. Existing Fly testing conveniences, reusable TMs and other earlier features carry forward. Back up your normal save before switching. Emulator save states belong to their exact ROM. Earlier patch pages remain unchanged.
